newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yields fall at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.

text.p: Yields fell at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers in the kingdom said.
The yield on 28-day bills was 5.6497 percent from 5.7130 last week and the rate on 91-day bills was 5.7777 from 5.8334.
The 182-day bills yielded 5.9453 percent from 6.0273 and the rate on 364-day bills was 6.2342 percent from 6.3741.
One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 and three-month funds were at 5-15/16, 13/16. Six-month deposits were 6-1/8, six and one-year interbank rates were at 6-3/8, 1/4.
